tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_threat_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_privateer_threat_pct value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_at_least_4_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_privateer_threat_pct value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_at_least_3_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_privateer_threat_pct value = 75 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_at_least_2_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_privateer_threat_pct value = 50 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_at_least_1_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_privateer_threat_pct value = 25 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_route_progress_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_venice_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_genoa_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_malta_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_tunis_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_palermo_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_candia_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_gibraltar_passed }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress min = 0 max = 8 }
}

tv_wonder_pharos_clear_privateers_effect = {
	location:alexandria = {
		sea_zone = {
			area = {
				every_privateer_in_area = {
					limit = { NOT = { owner = root } }
					change_privateer_power = -0.4
				}
			}
		}
	}
	tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_pharos_enter_stage_2_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_stage value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner
	add_prestige = 5
	change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_pharos_complete_selected_controlled_route_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_constantinople_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_venice_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_venice_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_venice_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_genoa_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_genoa_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_genoa_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_malta_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_malta_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_malta_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 4 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_tunis_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_tunis_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_tunis_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 5 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_palermo_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_palermo_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_palermo_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 6 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_candia_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_candia_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_candia_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 7 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_gibraltar_trigger = yes
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_gibraltar_pending_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_gibraltar_passed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 8 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress add = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_pharos_maybe_finish_routes_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_pharos_create_selected_route_basing_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner }
		create_relation = {
			first = root
			second = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
			type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights
		}
		create_relation = {
			first = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
			second = root
			type = relation_type:fleet_basing_rights
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner }
		tv_wonder_pharos_complete_selected_basing_route_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_evaluate_selected_route_effect = {

		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7305 days = 1 }
	}

		limit = {
			tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_constantinople_trigger = yes

tv_wonder_pharos_roll_route_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_has_pending_route_trigger = yes }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				trigger = { tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_pending_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 1 }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner
				location:constantinople = {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location
					root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes }
						owner = {
							save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner value = 1 } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { tv_wonder_pharos_route_venice_pending_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 2 }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner
				location:venice = {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location
					root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes }
						owner = {
							save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner value = 1 } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { tv_wonder_pharos_route_genoa_pending_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 3 }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner
				location:genoa = {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location
					root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes }
						owner = {
							save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner value = 1 } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
						}
					}
				}
			}

					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location
					root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes }
						owner = {
							save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner value = 1 } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			10 = {
				trigger = { tv_wonder_pharos_route_gibraltar_pending_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route value = 8 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_id value = 8 }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_status
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner
				location:gibraltar = {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location
					root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_location value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_location } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_owner = yes }
						owner = {
							save_scope_as = tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_event_route_has_owner value = 1 } }
							root = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route_owner value = scope:tv_wonder_pharos_selected_route_owner } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		tv_wonder_pharos_evaluate_selected_route_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		tv_wonder_pharos_maybe_finish_routes_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_maybe_finish_routes_effect = {
	tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_route_progress_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress
			var:tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress >= 8
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete_pending_event }
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete_pending_event value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7308 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_finish_ritual_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_hagia_advance_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_1_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_2_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_3_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_4_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 5 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_5_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 6 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 7 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_7_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step value = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 8 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_8_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event
	}
}

			estate_privilege:tv_hagia_great_church_endowment_privilege = {

					grant_estate_privilege = prev
				}
			}
		}
		tv_wonder_hagia_advance_step_effect = yes

	}

		33 = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost value = 2 } }
		34 = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost value = 3 } }
	}
}

tv_wonder_hagia_complete_step_6_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost var:tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost ?= 1 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost var:tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost ?= 2 }
		add_prestige = -5
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = -0.025 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = -0.025 }
		}
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_step_6_cost
	tv_wonder_hagia_advance_step_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_hagia_fire_step_event_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6301 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 2 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6302 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6303 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 4 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 4 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6304 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 5 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 5 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6305 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 6 }
		tv_wonder_hagia_roll_step_6_cost_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 6 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6306 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 7 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 7 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6307 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 8 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 8 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6308 days = 1 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_hagia_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_hagia_active_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_prosperity_active
				tv_wonder_hagia_constantinople_prosperous_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event value = 8 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.6308 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_prosperity_active }
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_pending_event }
				OR = {
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 1 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_1 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 2 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_2 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 3 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_3 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 4 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_4 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 5 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_5 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 6 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_6 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 7 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_7 }
					AND = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 8 has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_assignee_8 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_hagia_months } }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_months >= 3 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_hagia_months value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_wonder_hagia_step ?= 8 }
					tv_wonder_hagia_begin_step_8_procession_effect = yes
				}
				else = {
					tv_wonder_hagia_fire_step_event_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_snapshot_effect = {
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_id ?= 10101 }
		tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
		if = {
		  limit = {
		    has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_auxiliary_building_finished
		    NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_stage }
		  }
		  set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_stage value = 1 }
		  set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month value = 0 }
		  set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_route_progress value = 0 }
		  trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7300 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
		  limit = {
		    has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_stage
		    var:tv_wonder_pharos_stage ?= 1
		    NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete }
		  }
		  tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
		  change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month add = 1 }
		  if = {
		    limit = { var:tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month >= 3 }
		    set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month value = 0 }
		    if = {
		      limit = { tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_trigger = yes }
		      random_list = {
		        33 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7301 days = 1 } }
		        33 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7302 days = 1 } }
		        34 = { trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7303 days = 1 } }
		      }
		    }
		    else = {
		      trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.7304 days = 1 }
		    }
		  }
		}
		else_if = {
		  limit = {
		    has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_stage
		    var:tv_wonder_pharos_stage ?= 2
		    NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_routes_complete }
		  }
		  tv_wonder_pharos_refresh_display_effect = yes
		  change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month add = 1 }
		  if = {
		    limit = { var:tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month >= 3 }
		    set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_pharos_quarter_month value = 0 }
		    tv_wonder_pharos_roll_route_effect = yes
		  }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_selected_ritual_id ?= 10201 }
		tv_wonder_hagia_monthly_progress_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_timed_ritual_progress_display_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_progress_pct value = var:tv_wonder_ritual_months_completed }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_progress_pct multiply = 100 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_progress_pct divide = 12 }
	clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_progress_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_advance_timed_ritual_month_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_months_completed } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_months_completed value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_months_completed add = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_months_completed min = 0 max = 12 }
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_timed_ritual_progress_display_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
			tv_wonder_selected_ritual_completion_requirements_met_trigger = yes
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_completion_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_static_modifier_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_timer
		tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_selected_ritual_runtime_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress }
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_progress_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_confirm_ceremony_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_timed_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_artwork_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes }
			random_work_of_art_in_country = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork }
			destroy_art = scope:tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork
			if = {
				limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_static_modifier_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_scaled_gold_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_prestige_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_static_modifier_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
